_instructions: 1. Copy this file to vault-config.json:  cp vault-config.example.json vault-config.json
_security: vault-config.json is in .gitignore — it will NEVER be committed to git. Keep it safe!
_appsScriptSetup: See README.md for step-by-step setup. Takes 2 minutes. NO API console needed.
_cloudflareDeploy: To deploy on Cloudflare Pages with Zero Trust auth, see the README.md section 'Deploy to Cloudflare Pages + Zero Trust'.
_bankAccountsGuide: Bank details are read LOCALLY from this file. They are NEVER sent to any server, not even Google. The app reads them directly in your browser.
_googleDriveStructure: Create these folders in your Google Drive root: People/[Name]/ (with subfolders for Aadhaar, PAN, etc.), Vehicles/[VehicleName]/, Properties/[PropertyName]/, Shared_Documents/
